title: Urban renewal in Israel by city (pinui-binui / TAMA 38): Mitar open data
description: City-level figures on urban-renewal compounds and plans in Israel for 80 cities and local authorities, from government records only. For each city: declared compounds in the Authority track and the tax track and how many are approved, the median time from plan deposit to approval with its sample, and planned housing units. There is no score and no ranking. Processed by Mitar (mitar.co.il) from the Government Urban Renewal Authority's declared-compounds layer and data.gov.il table, and the Israel Planning Administration's Xplan. Not an official publication. The README documents every column, how it is computed, the source licences and the caveats. Current version, regenerated whenever the site is published: https://mitar.co.il/data/cities.json
